context: Yumiko discusses Sakura's author career proudly.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: さくらちゃん、本、増えて、嬉しい。
lines.en: Sakura, I'm so happy to see your book collection growing.
lines.style: Warm, admiring tone with genuine maternal affection. Soft opening on the name. Slow, unhurried pace—savoring the moment. A quiet smile beneath the words, pride settling comfortably in her voice.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お母さん、応援、本当に、感謝。
lines.en: Mom, I really do appreciate you supporting me.
lines.style: Sincere and tender, but grounded—not performative. A slight catch of emotion on the gratitude, held steady. Eye-contact directness. The words land simply, without reaching for more.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.en: It's really something the way you're chasing your dream.
lines.style: Genuine admiration, almost reverent in its gentleness. A pause before 'dream'—letting the weight of it settle. Warm, unhurried breath. No performance, just a mother recognising her daughter.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.en: I know everyone in our family is proud of you.
lines.style: Quiet conviction, without needing to convince. Gentle but grounded. The 'everyone' carries warmth—she's speaking for all of them. Steady, shoulder-level composure.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.en: You're so precious to me, truly.
lines.style: Intimate and undefended. The words arrive simply, without embellishment. A small breath before the closing—vulnerability wrapped in quietness. The 'truly' is almost to herself.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 一緒に、いつも、応援、感謝。
lines.en: And I'll always be here cheering you on.
lines.style: Steady promise, spoken with quiet assurance. No urgency, no overstating. A slight warmth in the lift of 'always.' The commitment sits naturally in her voice, as sure as it is understated.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.en: That's what the future holds for us, really.
lines.style: Closing with soft certainty. Unhurried, like watching something settle into place. A breath of contentment. The words trail into something that feels inevitable and right—warm, grounded, and complete.
